    [5,85,10,78,20,73,26,76,32,90,35,113,29,116,15,112,8,103],
    [27,114,34,103,44,98,52,101,61,114,66,135,59,138,42,132,31,125]
  ];
  const rightPaws = [
    [197,87,202,75,209,63,216,63,224,72,225,81,218,94,208,101,199,100],
    [139,101,143,88,150,77,157,77,169,87,175,99,167,111,154,120,143,118],
    [195,100,200,87,207,75,214,74,222,83,225,93,218,106,207,114,198,113],
    [168,130,174,117,183,105,190,104,200,114,205,125,197,137,182,145,171,145],
    [158,112,164,99,173,88,180,88,190,99,195,110,187,121,173,130,161,128],
    [196,99,201,85,208,74,214,74,222,83,225,92,218,105,207,113,198,112],
    [152,117,158,104,166,95,175,95,186,105,191,117,182,128,167,134,155,133],
    [192,119,198,105,206,93,214,93,222,101,224,112,217,125,204,135,194,132]
  ];
  // Head translation, face rotation, torso translation, chest highlight and paw turn.
  const poses = [
    [0,0,0,0,0,0,0],
    [2,1,12,-1,0,-18,1],
    [1,5,0,1,4,-1,.04],
    [0,11,8,-2,11,-15,.82],
    [1,7,7,-1,7,-13,.91],
    [0,2,0,0,2,-2,.02],
    [1.5,6,11,-1,6,-16,.96],
    [1,10,2,1,10,-5,.13]
  ];

  function outline(points) {
    const n = points.length / 2;
    const point = (i,k) => points[2*((i+n)%n)+k];
    let d = "M" + points[0] + " " + points[1];
    for (let i=0; i<n; i++) {
      const controls = [];
      for (let k=0; k<2; k++) {
        controls[k] = point(i,k) + .15*(point(i+1,k)-point(i-1,k));
        controls[k+2] = point(i+1,k) - .15*(point(i+2,k)-point(i,k));
        controls[k+4] = point(i+1,k);
      }
      d += "C" + controls.join(" ");
    }
    return d + "Z";
  }

  function render(t) {
    const el = id => document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el("character-grain")) return;
    const ms = ((t%1200)+1200)%1200;
    let i = 0;
    while (ms >= times[i+1]) i++;
    const next = (i+1)%8;
    const u = (ms-times[i])/(times[i+1]-times[i]);
    const weight = u*u*(3-2*u);
    const sample = table => table[i].map((a,k) => a+(table[next][k]-a)*weight);

    function limb(side,arms,paws) {
      el(side+"-sleeve").setAttribute("d",outline(sample(arms)));
      const paw = sample(paws);
      el(side+"-tip").setAttribute("d",outline(paw));
      el(side+"-glint").setAttribute("cx",paw[4]-2);
      el(side+"-glint").setAttribute("cy",paw[5]+5);
    }
    limb("left",leftArms,leftPaws);
    limb("right",rightArms,rightPaws);

    const [x,y,angle,bx,by,lx,turn] = sample(poses);
    el("head").setAttribute("transform",`translate(${x} ${y})`);
    el("face").setAttribute("transform",`rotate(${angle} 124 24)`);
    el("body").setAttribute("transform",`translate(${bx} ${by}) scale(1 ${1-by/245})`);
    el("belly-light").setAttribute("transform",`translate(${lx} ${by*.22})`);
    el("rightGold").setAttribute("x1",String(.12*turn));
    el("rightGold").setAttribute("y1",String(.48+.52*turn));
    el("rightGold").setAttribute("y2",String(.52-.48*turn));
  }

  window.nwb = {render:render};
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function () { render(0); },{once:true});
})();
</script>
